data.heading: ContractualElement
data.text: A contractual element is an element that forms part of a contract, such as a definition, condition, or commitment.

data.heading: Definition
data.text: A definition is a statement that explains the meaning of a term or concept as used within the domain object (e.g., a document).

data.heading: CityOrgThing
data.text: Added for organizational purposes, to identify classes defined in the City Organization ontology.

data.heading: Code
data.text: A code represents a possible set of values for a property, according to some predefined system of values.

data.heading: Building
data.text: A Building is a type of Infrastructure Element that is a structure with a roof and walls, such as a house, school, or factory. The location of a Building may change due to construction, but the Parcel/Lot of land it is located on cannot (i.e., moving an entire building results in a change in object instance).

data.heading: Bridge
data.text: A Bridge is a Infrastructure Element that enables travel over some obstacle or area. It may contain some Road Segments or Rail Line Segments.

data.heading: MainBylaw
data.text: A Main Bylaw is a legally enforceable rule that serves as the primary legislative document for a law within a Jurisdictional Area.

data.heading: ResidentialRelationship
data.text: A ResidentialRelationship defines the relationship of a Resident to a Residence.

data.heading: Street Direction
data.text: A StreetDirection defines the directional component of a street name.

data.heading: Warranty
data.text: A Warranty is a contractual promise of some indemnification if an assertion made in the Contract is false.

data.heading: Schedule
data.text: A Schedule is a component of a bylaw that outlines specific provisions, terms, or details related to the main content of the document.

data.heading: CityServiceThing
data.text: Added for organizational purposes, to identify classes defined in the City Service ontology.

data.heading: InfrastructureElement
data.text: An Infrastructure Element is a generic representation of a city structure of interest.

data.heading: Outcome
data.text: Outcomes are what stakeholders experience as a result of a Program or Service.

data.heading: Street Type
data.text: A StreetType defines the type of street.

data.heading: Service
data.text: A Program is composed of one or more Services.

data.heading: Gender
data.text: Gender is a type of Code that describes the gender identity of a person.

data.heading: Input
data.text: Input defines the resources and the stakeholders that are needed for an Activity.

data.heading: Law
data.text: A Law is an legally enforceable rule.

data.heading: TunnelSegment
data.text: A Tunnel Segment is a type of Infrastructure Element that represents part of a Tunnel.

data.heading: BuildingUse
data.text: Building Use is a type of Code that describes the use or function of a Building

data.heading: RevisionBylaw
data.text: A RevisionBylaw is a bylaw that amends an existing bylaw.

data.heading: Contract
data.text: A contract is a legally binding agreement between two or more parties.

data.heading: Occupation
data.text: Occupation describes the work performed by some Employee.

data.heading: Salary
data.text: A Salary is a form of compensation paid to an employee and is defined on an annual basis.

data.heading: JurisdictionalArea
data.text: A Jurisdictional Area is an abstract entity that is characterized not only by its location, but by the objects that occupy it (persons, buildings, etc), the governing body(s) it is subject to, and the activities that occur within it.

data.heading: Year
data.text: Represents a year in the Gregorian calendar.

data.heading: Goal
data.text: A goal represents some state or complex states, and allows for the representation of various groups' responsibilities.

data.heading: RailSegment
data.text: A Rail Segment is a type of Travelled Way Segment that represents part of a Rail Link.

data.heading: BylawTypeCode
data.text: A code identifying whether a bylaw is a main, amending, or revision bylaw.

data.heading: City
data.text: A City is a specialization of a Jurisdictional Area that is formally identified as such.

data.heading: Education
data.text: Education is a type of Code that describes the educational background of a person.

data.heading: CityThing
data.text: Added for organizational purposes, to identify classes defined for the city-level CDM ontology.

data.heading: CityPatternThing
data.text: Added for organizational purposes, to identify classes defined in the City Services part of the City Data Model.

data.heading: TravelledWaySegment
data.text: A Travelled Way Segment is a type of Infrastructure Element that represents part of a Travelled Way Link.

data.heading: TransportInfrastructureThing
data.text: Added for organizational purposes, to identify classes defined in the Transport Infrastructure Pattern ontology.

data.heading: Facility
data.text: A facility is a physical location or structure that provides services or amenities to the public or a specific group of people.

data.heading: State
data.text: A State is a political subdivision of a country.

data.heading: Clause
data.text: A Clause is a statement of a rule, provision, requirement, etc. that is part of the body of the Law, or its schedules, penalties, etc.

data.heading: TravelledWay
data.text: A Travelled Way is a type of Infrastructure Element that enables travel.

data.heading: LegislationLegalForceCode
data.text: A code identifying whether a law is in force, not in force, or partially in force.

data.heading: PersonThing
data.text: Added for organizational purposes, to identify classes defined in the Person ontology.

data.heading: Country
data.text: A Country is a specialization of a Jurisdictional Area that is formally identified as such.

data.heading: Name
data.text: A Name represents a formal name given to an entity and is a superclass for all more descriptive name types.

data.heading: RailLink
data.text: A Rail Link is a type of Travelled Way Link that represents a length of RailLine.

data.heading: InfrastructureThing
data.text: Added for organizational purposes, to identify classes defined in the Infrastructure pattern.

data.heading: ControlledEntity
data.text: A controlled entity is an entity that is subject to control by another entity.

data.heading: HomeType
data.text: Home Type is a type of Code that describes the type of a Residence.

data.heading: ConstructionStatus
data.text: Construction Status is a type of Code that describes the construction status of a Building or Infrastructure Element.

data.heading: Alert
data.text: An Alert can be used to notify people of important information.

data.heading: Operation
data.text: An Operation defines the regular opening hours of an Organization or Infrastructure Element.

data.heading: CityResidentThing
data.text: Added for organizational purposes, to identify classes defined in the City Resident ontology.

data.heading: LandUseClassification
data.text: Land Use Classification is a type of Code that describes the use of a Land Area.

data.heading: CityAdministrativeArea
data.text: Jurisdictional Area that has been identified for use by a City to reflect its unique areas such as districts, wards, neighbourhoods, or prefectures.

data.heading: Stakeholder
data.text: A Stakeholder is an Organization or Person that has an interest in a Program or Service.

data.heading: EmploymentStatus
data.text: Employment Status is a type of Code that describes the employment status of an Agent within an Organization.

data.heading: Address
data.text: Address is the main concept for a contact.  It has been designed to represent any type of address in the world, including India and the UK.  For example, the property hasBuilding is important in many UK and Indian addresses to further identify the person or business location. Street information is divided into separate properties to fully identify direction (hasStreetDirection), Type (hasStreetType), etc.

data.heading: IndustryType
data.text: Industry Type is a type of Code that describes the industry sector of a business establishment.

data.heading: Sex
data.text: Sex is a type of Code that describes the biological sex of a person.

data.heading: AmendingBylaw
data.text: An Amending Bylaw is a type of Bylaw that modifies or updates an existing bylaw.

data.heading: Person
data.text: A Person is an individual human being.

data.heading: CodeThing
data.text: Added for organizational purposes, to identify classes defined in the Code ontology.

data.heading: Employment
data.text: Employment is a type of Organizational membership in which the Agent receives monetary compensation for the value that they provide to the Organization.

data.heading: Household
data.text: A Household refers to a collection of persons occupying a shared place of residence. Households may or may not be comprised of family members.

data.heading: RoadLink
data.text: A Road Link is a type of Travelled Way Link that represents a length of Road.

data.heading: Output
data.text: Output is a quantitative summary of an activity.

data.heading: LandArea
data.text: A Land Area is a defined geographic area of land.

data.heading: ForProfitOrganization
data.text: A for-profit organization is an organization that operates with the primary goal of generating profit for its owners or shareholders.

data.heading: NonBindingTerm
data.text: A NonBindingTerm is a term in a contract that does not have legal force.

data.heading: Representation
data.text: Part of the Contract that specifies some assertions that are taken to be true at the time of the contract and serve to influence a party's decision to enter into the Contract.

data.heading: Phone Number
data.text: A PhoneNumber defines the complete international phone number and type of number.

data.heading: ContractThing
data.text: Added for organizational purposes, to identify classes defined in the Contract ontology.

data.heading: BusinessEstablishment
data.text: Business Establishment: A Business establishment is a physical location where an Organization conducts business.

data.heading: BylawThing
data.text: Added for organizational purposes, to identify classes defined in the Bylaw ontology.

data.heading: ContractualCommitment
data.text: A contractual commitment is a legally binding part of a contract that consists of a promise made by a party in relation to the contract.

data.heading: ConditionPrecedent
data.text: A condition precedent is a condition that must be met before a contract becomes effective.

data.heading: BuildingThing
data.text: Added for organizational purposes, to identify classes defined in the Building ontology.

data.heading: CityResident
data.text: A City Resident is a Person who satisfies the requirements of being a city resident for the particular City.

data.heading: Address Type
data.text: Address Type is a type of Code that describes the type of address, such as residential, business, or mailing.

data.heading: Skill
data.text: Skill is a type of Code that describes a specific ability or competency of a person.

data.heading: Road
data.text: A Road is a type of Travelled Way that describes a part of the physical transport infrastructure that has been improved to allow travel by motor vehicles, persons, bicycles, or similar methods of conveyance. road vehicles. No distinction is made between Road types at this level.

data.heading: EntityOperation
data.text: Activity of operating an Organization by City Resident.

data.heading: NonProfitOrganization
data.text: A NonProfitOrganization is an non-governmental organization that operates for purposes other than generating profit.

data.heading: AlertThing
data.text: Added for organizational purposes, to identify classes defined for the Alert Pattern.

data.heading: RailLine
data.text: A Rail Line is a type of Travelled Way that describes a part of the physical transportation infrastructure that has been fitted with tracks to allow travel by trains and other sorts of rail vehicles. No distinction is made between Rail Line types at this level.

data.heading: ImpactDirection
data.text: Impact Direction is a type of Code that describes the direction of impact of an event or action.

data.heading: LandUseThing
data.text: Added for organizational purposes, to identify classes defined in the Land Use ontology.

data.heading: TravelledWayLink
data.text: A Travelled Way Link represents a continuous length of a Travelled Way and is a type of Infrastructure Element that connects two or more Travelled Way Segments.

data.heading: ContractualDefinition
data.text: A contractual definition is a definition of a term used within a contract.

data.heading: EntityOwnership
data.text: Activity of owning a Building, Land Area, or Organization by City Resident.

data.heading: Tunnel
data.text: A Tunnel is a Infrastructure Element that enables travel through or underneath some obstacle or area. It may contain some Road or RailLine Segments.

data.heading: OrganizationAgent
data.text: Member of an organization

data.heading: Citizenship
data.text: Citizenship is a type of City Thing that indicates the country of citizenship for a person during a specific period.

data.heading: Organization
data.text: An Organization defined broadly as a formal or semi-formal group for which structure and behaviour are defined.

data.heading: PersonId
data.text: Person ID is a type of City Thing that represents an identification document issued to a person by an authoritative body.

data.heading: IDType
data.text: ID Type is a type of Code that describes the type of identification document issued to a person.

data.heading: Role
data.text: A Role has a single, possibly complex, Goal.

data.heading: BuildingUnit
data.text: A part of a Building which may be occupied by some Persons or Organization.

data.heading: Bylaw
data.text: A bylaw is a law that is passed by a lower hierarchical entity that gains its authority from a government authority.

data.heading: Program
data.text: A program is a major city initiative to address the needs of constituents (citizens, clients). A Program defines a set of services that focus on achieving a shared set of Outcomes.

data.heading: Wage
data.text: A Wage is a form of compensation paid to an employee and is defined on an hourly basis.

data.heading: Compensation
data.text: A compensation is a generalization of monetary compensation received for employment.

data.heading: Importance
data.text: Importance is a type of Code that describes the level of importance of an event or action.

data.heading: RoadSegment
data.text: A Road Segment is a type of Travelled Way Segment that represents part of a Road Link.

data.heading: ContactThing
data.text: Added for organizational purposes, to identify classes defined in the Contact ontology.

data.heading: Phone Type
data.text: A PhoneType defines the type of phone number.

data.heading: CatchmentAreaType
data.text: Catchment Area Type is a type of Code that describes the type of catchment area that stakeholders represent

data.heading: HouseholdThing
data.text: Added for organizational purposes, to identify classes defined in the Household ontology.

data.heading: CityOrgObjectProperty
data.text: Added for organizational purposes, to identify object properties defined for the City Organization Pattern in the City-level CDM ontology.

data.heading: annualPay
data.text: Identifies the compensation to be paid for a year.

data.heading: employedAs
data.text: Identifies the occupation in which the agent is employed.

data.heading: employedBy
data.text: Identifies the Organization that employs the agent.

data.heading: hasCompensation
data.text: identifies the monetary compensation received by the agent.

data.heading: hasEmployment
data.text: Specifies the details of an agent’s Employment.

data.heading: hasEmploymentStatus
data.text: identifies the Employment Status of the employee.

data.heading: hasEstablishment
data.text: Specifies a Business Establishment where the organization conducts business.

data.heading: hasGoal
data.text: identifies the Goal(s) of the domain object.

data.heading: hasGovernment
data.text: Identifies the GovernmentOrganization that manages the JurisdictionalArea.

data.heading: hasIndustryType
data.text: Specifies an Industry Type assigned to the organization based on the kind of business conducted.

data.heading: hasPay
data.text: Identifies the MonetaryValue of the Compensation.

data.heading: hasProcess
data.text: Specifies an Activity that is performed as part of the Role.

data.heading: hasProgram
data.text: Specifies a Program defined for the Organization.

data.heading: hasResource
data.text: Specifies a resource:Resource that is (expected to be) allocated for the Role.

data.heading: hourlyPay
data.text: Identifies the Compensation to be paid per hour.

data.heading: jurisdiction
data.text: Specifies the JurisdictionalArea for which the organization is responsible.

data.heading: operatingHours
data.text: Identifies the OperatingHours of the Organization.

data.heading: orgAddress
data.text: A specialization to hasAddress that specifies the Address associated with the Organization.

data.heading: overtimePay
data.text: Identifies an additional rate of pay as a MonetaryValue to be paid per hour in the case of overtime compensation.

data.heading: playsRole
data.text: Specifies a Role that the domain object fulfils.

data.heading: PersonObjectProperty
data.text: Added for organizational purposes, to identify object properties defined for the Person Pattern in the City-level CDM ontology.

data.heading: alias
data.text: Identifies any alternative names associated with a Person.

data.heading: birthDate
data.text: Identifies the time:Instant when the Person was born.

data.heading: birthplace
data.text: Identifies the place where the Person was born.

data.heading: children
data.text: Identifies any children of a person.

data.heading: citizenOf
data.text: specifies one or more Citizenships, each specifying the country (Country) and time interval (time:ProperInterval) the Person is a citizen. A Person can be a citizen of more than one country and for different time intervals. It is recommended that a Country be defined with using ISO 3166-2 [4] alpha-2 (2-letter) country code, however different systems may be accommodated with the Code pattern.

data.heading: deathDate
data.text: Identifies the time:Instant when the Person died.

data.heading: deathPlace
data.text: Identifies the place where the Person died.

data.heading: forCountry
data.text: Identifies the country for which the Person is a citizen for the given dates.

data.heading: hasEducation
data.text: Identifies the education of a person.

data.heading: hasGenderIdentity
data.text: Identifies the gender identity of a person.

data.heading: hasIDType
data.text: Specifies the type of identifier, its values may be defined more precisely with the use of the code:hasCode property.

data.heading: hasPersonID
data.text: Identifies any instances of a Person’s PersonId.

data.heading: hasSkill
data.text: Identifies the skills of a person.

data.heading: income
data.text: Identifies the annual income of a person.

data.heading: issuedBy
data.text: Identifies the Agent that issued the ID, document, or certificate.

data.heading: name
data.text: Identifies the instance of Name legally associated with an Object (e.g., Person).

data.heading: parent
data.text: Identifies any parents of the Person.

data.heading: sex
data.text: Identifies a Person's sex assigned at birth.

data.heading: spouse
data.text: Identifies any spouses of the person.

data.heading: validityPeriod
data.text: Identifies the time interval during which the identifier is valid.

data.heading: CityObjectProperty
data.text: Added for organizational purposes, to identify object properties defined for city-level CDM ontology.

data.heading: CodeObjectProperty
data.text: Added for organizational purposes, to identify object properties defined for the Code Pattern in the City-level CDM ontology.

data.heading: definedBy
data.text: Identifies the Organization that defined the Code.

data.heading: hasCode
data.text: Identifies the code for the domain object.

data.heading: LandUseObjectProperty
data.text: Added for organizational purposes, to identify object properties defined in the Land Use ontology.

data.heading: hasArea
data.text: identifies the size of a Land Area

data.heading: hasLandArea
data.text: Identifies the spatial area occupied by the object.

data.heading: hasPopulation
data.text: Specifies the number of people living in the LandArea.

data.heading: landUse
data.text: Identifies a Land Use Classification that is identified for the Land Area.

data.heading: TransportInfrastructureObjectProperty
data.text: Added for organizational purposes, to identify object properties defined for the Transport Infrastructure Pattern in the City-level CDM ontology.

data.heading: networkType
data.text: Identifies the type of network.

data.heading: supports
data.text: Identifies the infrastructure element that is supported (carried in or carried through) the current (domain) object.

data.heading: CityPatternObjectProperty
data.text: Added for organizational purposes, to identify object properties defined in the City-level CDM ontology.

data.heading: administrativeArea
data.text: Identifies administrative areas within the JurisdictionalArea.

data.heading: administrativeAreaOf
data.text: Identifies the jurisdictional area that an administrative area belongs to.

data.heading: residentPopulation
data.text: Number of residents of the area.

data.heading: BuildingObjectProperty
data.text: Added for organizational purposes, to identify object properties defined for the Building Pattern in the City-level CDM ontology.

data.heading: buildingFacility
data.text: Identifies a Facility that is contained in the Building.

data.heading: floorAreaRatio
data.text: Identifies the building's floor area ratio. This is a ratio of the gross floor area (the value of hasBuildingFloorArea) to its “buildable area” (i.e. lot size).

data.heading: floorToCeilingHeight
data.text: Identifies the floor to ceiling height in the Building Unit.

data.heading: hasBuildingFloorArea
data.text: identifies the floor area occupied by the Building. The floor area accounts for the area of each floor of the building. However, floor area excludes unoccupied areas such as basements.

data.heading: hasBuildingFootprintArea
data.text: Identifies the footprint occupied by the Building.

data.heading: hasBuildingHeight
data.text: Identifies the Building’s height.

data.heading: hasBuildingUnit
data.text: Identifies the Building Unit(s), if any, that are contained by the Building.

data.heading: hasConstructionStatus
data.text: identifies the Construction Status of a Building.

data.heading: hasRent
data.text: Identifies the rental fee for the Building Unit.

data.heading: hasUnitSize
data.text: Identifies the size of the Building Unit as an Area.

data.heading: unitInBuilding
data.text: Identifies the Building that the Building Unit belongs to (is contained in).

data.heading: use
data.text: Identifies the use of the Building, typically associated with some classification system.

data.heading: windowToWallRatio
data.text: Identifies the percentage area of a building’s exterior envelope that is made up of glazing (i.e., glass installed in fixed openings such as windows and doors).

data.heading: yearOfConstruction
data.text: Identifies the year that construction on the Building was completed.

data.heading: ContractObjectProperty
data.text: Added for organizational purposes, to identify object properties defined for the Contract Pattern in the City-level CDM ontology.

data.heading: contractualElementOf
data.text: Identifies the Contract of which this Contractual Element is a part.

data.heading: hasContract
data.text: Identifies the Contract associated with the domain object.

data.heading: hasContractualElement
data.text: Identifies the decomposition of a Contract into more precise parts.

data.heading: hasParty
data.text: Identifies all Persons or Organizations involved in the Contract.

data.heading: hasSignatory
data.text: identifies the Person(s) responsible for signing the Contract.

data.heading: isExecutedOn
data.text: identifies the Interval or Instant in time at which the terms in the Contract are executed, if applicable.

data.heading: isValidFor
data.text: Identifies the Interval in time over which the domain object is valid.

data.heading: specifiesAgreement
data.text: Identifies an agreement that is specified by the domain object.

data.heading: CityServiceObjectProperty
data.text: Added for organizational purposes, to identify object properties defined for the City Service Pattern in the City-level CDM ontology.

data.heading: fromPerspectiveOf
data.text: Identifies the Stakeholder who is determining the importance of the Impact.

data.heading: hasBeneficialStakeholder
data.text: Identifies the Stakeholder who is benefiting from the object.

data.heading: hasCatchmentArea
data.text: Identifies the regional span of the stakeholders.

data.heading: hasCatchmentAreaType
data.text: Identifies the type of regional span of the stakeholders.

data.heading: hasContributingStakeholder
data.text: Identifies the stakeholders that contribute to the domain object.

data.heading: hasImportance
data.text: Specifies how important the Outcome is.

data.heading: hasIndicator
data.text: identifies an Indicator used to measure to the Outcome.

data.heading: hasInput
data.text: Identifies an input used in the domain object.

data.heading: hasOutcome
data.text: Identifies the Outcomes or expected Outcomes of the domain object.

data.heading: hasOutput
data.text: Identifies an output produced by the domain object.

data.heading: hasService
data.text: Identifies the Services that make up the domain object.

data.heading: intendedImpact
data.text: identifies the intended impact.

data.heading: performs
data.text: Identifies activities performed by the domain object.

data.heading: usedByIndicator
data.text: Identifies the Indicators that use this Output in determining the value of the Indicator.

data.heading: AlertObjectProperty
data.text: Added for organizational purposes, to identify all object properties defined in the Alert Pattern.

data.heading: activities
data.text: activities that caused the described object

data.heading: beginInstant
data.text: The time that the described object began or is expected to begin. If not specified, the object is assumed to begin at the creation time.

data.heading: category
data.text: A code indicating the category of the described object.

data.heading: cause
data.text: A code indicating the cause (e.g., construction, collision, weather) of the described object.

data.heading: certainty
data.text: The likelihood of the condition occurring.

data.heading: creationInstant
data.text: The time that the described object was created.

data.heading: distribution
data.text: A code indicating the groups who are authorized to receive the object.

data.heading: effect
data.text: A code indicating the effect of the alert (e.g., congestion, delays).

data.heading: endInstant
data.text: The time that the described object is expected to end; if no end time is specified, it is assumed to be indeterminate.

data.heading: expiryInstant
data.text: The time at which the information for the described object is considered no longer valid unless this value is updated.

data.heading: issuer
data.text: Entity that issued the alert

data.heading: lastUpdateInstant
data.text: The time at which the alert was last updated.

data.heading: location
data.text: A geographic area associated with the alert.

data.heading: recommendation
data.text: A code providing advice on actions to take (e.g., evacuate, shelter in-place).

data.heading: referencedAlert
data.text: Other alerts associated with this alert.

data.heading: resources
data.text: additional files that provide additional information

data.heading: severity
data.text: A code indicating the expected severity of the condition (e.g., life threatening, injury potential).

data.heading: status
data.text: The operational status.

data.heading: urgency
data.text: The urgency associated with distributing the alert.

data.heading: AddressProperty
data.text: Added for organizational purposes, to identify properties related to an address.

data.heading: ContactObjectProperty
data.text: Added for organizational purposes, to identify object properties defined for the Contact Pattern in the City-level CDM ontology.

data.heading: hasAddress
data.text: Specifies the address of the object.

data.heading: has Address Type
data.text: specifies the type of address.

data.heading: hasCity
data.text: Specifies the name of the city for the address.

data.heading: has Country
data.text: Specifies the country for the address.

data.heading: has Phone Type
data.text: Specifies the type of phone number.

data.heading: has Province
data.text: Specifies the state or province for the address.

data.heading: has Street Direction
data.text: Specifies the direction of the street for the address.

data.heading: has Street Type
data.text: specifies the type of the street for the address.

data.heading: has Telephone
data.text: Identifies the PhoneNumber for the domain object.

data.heading: BylawObjectProperty
data.text: Added for organizational purposes, to identify object properties defined for bylaws in the City-level CDM ontology.

data.heading: clauseType
data.text: A Code indicating a clause type of a clause within a Law or similar official document.

data.heading: hasBylaw
data.text: Identifies the bylaws in existence in the JurisdictionalArea.

data.heading: hasClause
data.text: Clauses that make up the body of the domain object.

data.heading: hasDefinition
data.text: Words or phrases that are defined to have a specific meaning within the domain object.

data.heading: hasPenaltyClause
data.text: Identifies the Clauses that specify penalties for not adhering to the domain object.

data.heading: hasRepealClause
data.text: Clauses that specify all previous Laws that deal with subjects that are addressed in the new bylaw must either be repealed or amended.

data.heading: hasSchedule
data.text: Schedules that are attached to the Law and are referenced by the Law. A Schedule is part of the Law.

data.heading: hasSeveranceClause
data.text: Clauses that specify that the bylaw remains valid if any portion of the Law is found to be invalid by a higher jurisdiction.

data.heading: hasTransitionClause
data.text: Clauses that cover the period during which entities affected by the Law can do things to conform to the new conditions.

data.heading: impacts
data.text: Identifies what is impacted by the domain object.

data.heading: legislationChanges
data.text: The Bylaw that is being amended.

data.heading: legislationJurisdiction
data.text: Identifies the jurisdiction that enacted the Law.

data.heading: legislationLegalForce
data.text: Specifies whether the Law is currently in force, not in force or partially in force.

data.heading: legislationType
data.text: Type of bylaw chosen from mainBylaw, amendingBylaw or revisionBylaw.

data.heading: CityResidentObjectProperty
data.text: Added for organizational purposes, to identify object properties defined for the City Resident Pattern in the City-level CDM ontology.

data.heading: entity
data.text: Identifies an entity that is the subject domain object.

data.heading: forCity
data.text: Identifies the City of the residence.

data.heading: hasHomeType
data.text: Identifies the type of home.

data.heading: hasResidence
data.text: Specifies a Residence of a CityResident.

data.heading: hasResidentialRelationship
data.text: Specifies the type of residential relationship that exists.

data.heading: operates
data.text: Specifies an EntityOperation where the entity is an Organization that the resident operates.

data.heading: owns
data.text: Identifies an entity that is owned by another entity.

data.heading: residentOf
data.text: Identifies the JurisdictionalArea that a CityResident is a resident.

data.heading: HouseholdObjectProperty
data.text: Added for organizational purposes, to identify object properties defined for the Household Pattern in the City-level CDM ontology.

data.heading: householdOccupies
data.text: Identifies the Residence that the Household occupies. A Household is defined by this residence, such that if the members move (even collectively), the new residence constitutes a new Household.
